""" def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page that safely embeds user-provided content. Parameters ---------- visitor_content : str The string supplied by the user to be displayed in the page. Returns ------- str The complete HTML document with the user content safely escaped. """ # Escape special characters to prevent injection (CWE-74). safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
